issue.positionEn: A building or a silhouette reads from a distance. Step closer and the materials, techniques and labour holding it together come into view.
issue.introEn: London Museum opens beneath the glass roof of an old market, and Ilmin Museum of Art suspends wire and prisms in its atrium. Student posters in Tokyo ask for a step back. A G-SHOCK engraving calls for a turn of the wrist. This edition looks at the distance each of the last few days' exhibitions, releases and recordings asks from us.
issue.closingEn: Look at the whole poster before searching for the word. Listen to the studio version of Your Funeral… My Trial before returning to the Manchester footage. Give yourself room to change position.
